newsitem.title: UK: TI shares up as results and dividend impress.
newsitem.headline: TI shares up as results and dividend impress.

text.p: Shares in TI Group Plc climbed on Wednesday after the engineering company announced annual profits in-line with expectations and a dividend higher than most analysts had forecast.
The shares were 15p higher at 579 by 0917 GMT.
"The results looked solid and the dividend seems to have impressed people," one market-maker said.
TI announced 1996 pre-exceptional, pre-tax profits of 211.1 million stg and a total dividend of 14.5 pence per share.
Analysts had forecast pre-tax profits of between 208 and 215 million stg and a dividend of 14.3 pence.
